## Classes

### `class DualRNG`

DualRNG - Manages synchronized and visual RNGs

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `constructor` | `constructor(syncSeed = 42069)` |  |
| `resetSync` | `resetSync(seed = null)` | Reset synchronized RNG to initial state Call this when resyncing with server |
| `resetVisual` | `resetVisual(seed = null)` | Reset visual RNG (optional, for testing) |
| `sync` | `sync()` | Get synchronized random number [0, 1) MUST be called in same order on all clients! |
| `syncInt` | `syncInt(min, max)` | Synchronized random integer in range [min, max] inclusive |
| `syncFloat` | `syncFloat(min, max)` | Synchronized random float in range [min, max) |
| `syncBool` | `syncBool(probability = 0.5)` | Synchronized random boolean with given probability |
| `syncChoice` | `syncChoice(array)` | Synchronized random item from array |
| `syncShuffle` | `syncShuffle(array)` | Synchronized shuffle (Fisher-Yates) |
| `visual` | `visual()` | Get visual random number [0, 1) Does NOT need to sync across clients |
| `visualInt` | `visualInt(min, max)` | Visual random integer in range [min, max] inclusive |
| `visualFloat` | `visualFloat(min, max)` | Visual random float in range [min, max) |
| `visualBool` | `visualBool(probability = 0.5)` | Visual random boolean |
| `visualChoice` | `visualChoice(array)` | Visual random item from array |
| `atPosition` | `atPosition(x, y, z)` | Get deterministic random value for a position Same position always returns same value |
| `intAtPosition` | `intAtPosition(x, y, z, min, max)` | Get deterministic int at position |
| `floatAtPosition` | `floatAtPosition(x, y, z, min, max)` | Get deterministic float at position |
| `boolAtPosition` | `boolAtPosition(x, y, z, probability = 0.5)` | Get deterministic bool at position |
| `getState` | `getState()` | Get current state for sync verification |
| `verifySyncState` | `verifySyncState(otherState)` | Verify sync state matches another client |
| `enableLogging` | `enableLogging()` | Enable call logging for debugging sync issues |
| `getSyncLog` | `getSyncLog()` | Get sync call log for comparison with other clients |
| `compareLogs` | `static compareLogs(log1, log2)` | Compare sync logs from two clients to find divergence point |

## Functions

### `positionHash(x, y, z, seed = 0)`

Position-based hash for deterministic randomness at specific coordinates Useful for terrain generation where you need same result for same position

### `getGlobalRNG()`

Get or create global DualRNG instance

### `initGlobalRNG(seed)`

Initialize global RNG with seed (call from game init)
